mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) signals rising economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite GDPC1 increasing by >5% over the quarter, or Rank IC < 0.05 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in PAYEMS (labor) above 154,000 indicates strong job growth, prompting positive S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS crosses above 154000 but 20d returns are not positive, or t-test p > 0.05 showing no significant effect.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly increases in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) signal robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns negative despite both proxies rising, or IC <0.03 over 60d horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'monetary tightening cycle', a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.2% reduces growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns positive despite FEDFUNDS rising in a tightening cycle, or IC >0.05 in the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE (unemployment rate) below 3.5% signals labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5d returns negative despite UNRATE falling below 3.5%, or t-test p>0.05 showing no effect.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in INDPRO (supply) above 105.0 indicates robust production growth, prompting positive S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO crosses above 105 but 20d returns not positive, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 (demand) and PAYEMS (labor) indicate strong economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5d returns negative despite both proxies rising, or IC <0.03 over 5d.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'post-shock recovery' regime, simultaneous easing of FEDFUNDS (downward trend) and rising INDPRO (supply) signal recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60d returns negative despite FEDFUNDS falling and INDPRO rising, or IC <0.03 over 60d.
